coefficient_provenance.composed_ratio: D(X)/A_H(X)>=c/(c+1), up to the additive constant

definitions.A_H_Y: hard roots whose visible seed-2 chain is all holes at Y
definitions.D_4Y: splitless roots whose seed-2 chain first reaches G by 4Y
definitions.Hall_edge: a hard root h may use either labelled copy of e when e<=2h
definitions.downward_supply: members of D(4Y) with root e<=Y

uniform_lemma_checked_contract.fresh_shell_identity: D(4Y)=D_{e<=Y}(4Y)+#{Y<e<=2Y: e splitless and 2e-1 in G}.
uniform_lemma_checked_contract.name: quarter-shell Hall equivalence
uniform_lemma_checked_contract.statement: If 2D(4z)>=7A_H(z) for every z<=Y, the graph on H_Y and two copies of D(4Y), with e adjacent to h iff e<=2h, has an integral matching giving seven slots to every h; any such matching implies 2D(4Y)>=7A_H(Y).
